title: Understanding DataFrame Filtering
text: When filtering a DataFrame, ensure that the condition inside the brackets is correctly specified. For example, to filter rows where the 'generation' is $$6$$, you would use $$`consoles['generation']==6`$$. This condition should be inside the brackets of the DataFrame.

title: Using loc for Row Selection
text: The `loc` method is used to select rows and columns by labels. If you want to select rows based on a condition, ensure that the condition is applied before using `loc`. For example, to select rows where the 'year' is less than $$2000$$, you should apply this condition before using `loc`.

title: Combining Conditions
text: To filter data based on multiple conditions, you can combine them using the `&` operator. Ensure each condition is enclosed in parentheses. For example, to filter for generation $$6$$ and year less than $$2000$$, you would use $$`(consoles['generation']==6)$$ & $$consoles[primesymbolyearprimesymbol]<2000`$$.
